dogecoin.text:
This is remarkable -
Dogecoin is confirmed mathematically 
on the block-chain faster - for 1 minute ,
as compared to 10 minutes for Bitcoin.

It also has lower transaction fees.

Seems excellent for daily payments and  leaving a  tip .🌟
